defs.def: houses, flats/apartments, etc. that people live in, especially when referring to their type, price or condition （统称，尤指住房类型、价格、条件）住房，住宅

ex.s: Housing development pushed into the woods.
ex.t: 住宅开发区向林地推进。

ex.s: Such housing is dark inside so it took time for our eyes to adjust.
ex.t: 这种住房内部很暗，所以我们的眼睛需要时间来适应。

ex.s: The nursing home, located on a housing estate, has more than 150 senior citizens, some of whom are over 90 years old.
ex.t: 这家养老院坐落在一个住宅区内，住着 150 多位老人，其中一些已经超过 90 岁了。

defs.def: the job of providing houses, flats/apartments, etc. for people to live in 住房供给
a hard cover that protects part of a machine （机器的）外壳，套
